title: Neural network analysis implicates noncoding de novo variants in congenital heart disease
summary: Genomes of 749 congenital heart disease probands and parents were compared with 1,611 unaffected trios. Neural-network prediction of transcriptional impact of noncoding de novo variants identified a burden in CHD (2,238 versus 4,177 variants; P = 8.7e-4), supported by separate enhancer analyses; 5 of 31 assayed enhancers showed altered transcription with CHD variants.
ai_technology: Neural-network prediction of transcriptional impact of noncoding de novo variants
organization: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

evidence.tested: Case-control trio sequencing data analysed for burden; reporter assays of 31 enhancers.
evidence.unknown: The neural network is one of several analyses; individual variants not shown to be causal; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A neural network scored the transcriptional impact of de novo variants, one of several analyses supporting the burden finding.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
